headline: Five more arcade cabinets learn to play themselves
lede: WATCH batch 4 landed: Zork I, RobotLab, FloorBoss, Iron Ring and Rally Co-Driver now run their proven drivers behind the Y key — 33 of 80 titles. Two real bugs fell out of the way: the RobotLab guide was seating into a dead simulator, and offline Iron Ring players had been pinned on the attract screen since October.

notes.text: Zork answers 'N' at the Q/N prompts and leaves half-typed words alone; Zork II and III keep the honest 'no guide yet' until the brain is proven there.
Iron Ring's attract screen actually reaches character select now — the check that was supposed to prove it had been passing vacuously since the bug shipped. Two new gates pin the real path.

The three-week 'null React' mystery on dev servers has a root cause filed: the optimizer bundles two copies of React and the app renders against the one nobody hands the dispatcher to. Evidence in issue #1622.
watchcheck itself is in no CI job — 44 pilots that have never run. The one-line wiring is queued ahead of batch 5.
